summary: Verified UNO black screen bug fix via code review. The fix implements proper guards to prevent empty/invalid UNO renders and clears stale state on game close. Live two-user UNO testing not possible in single-session environment, but code-level verification confirms all requirements are met.
critical_code_review_comments: Match.js Line 227-232: handleUnoStarted validates game_state.player1_id and player2_id before rendering - blocks invalid UNO opens
Match.js Line 229-231: If invalid game_state, sets gameLoading(null), unoGameState(null), shows error toast, returns early
Match.js Line 234-237: Only sets activeGame('uno') and unoGameState if valid game_state arrives
Match.js Line 573-596: closeGame clears unoGameState to null - prevents stale state on second open
Match.js Line 469-471: startGame checks state === 'matched' before allowing game start
Match.js Line 473-476: startGame validates socket, sessionId, partner?.user_id before emitting
UnoGame.jsx Line 430-433: Returns null if !isOpen or missing session context (sessionId, myUserId, partnerUsername)
UnoGame.jsx Line 363-375: useEffect resets local state (gameState, gameEnded, winner) when initialGameState is null
context_for_next_testing_agent: UNO black screen bug fix verified via code review. Guards prevent empty UNO renders (handleUnoStarted validates player IDs), stale state cleared on close (closeGame sets unoGameState=null), and UnoGame.jsx returns null without valid session context. Live two-user UNO testing requires WebSocket connection between two browser sessions which is not feasible in single-session automation.
